ui.tile_count_hint: More tiles. The same square size.
ui.rail_note: Find the pattern in the unknown.
ui.help_intro: Explore every safe tile to complete the survey. Each number counts dangerous cores in neighboring tiles that share an edge or corner. Mark the tiles you suspect. Music starts after your first interaction; the top-right controls let you mute music and sound effects separately.
ui.help_cube: The default Carved cube opens with 216 tiles, 30 cores, and 75% recess depth. Every tile is an equal-sized square, and numbers sit flat on its face. Adjust Recess depth to change the stepped silhouette. More settings contains Cut style, Tile count, and Core density. Generate cube applies your choices. At 85% depth, two additional corner recesses begin to open. Tiles sharing an edge or corner are neighbors, including across ridges and inside corners. Hover or focus a tile to see its full neighborhood. Rotate to reach the back; every side counts toward completion.
ui.help_actions: Click to explore. Right-click or press and hold to mark. On touch screens, you can also switch to Mark in the toolbar.
ui.help_chord: When the nearby marks match a tile’s number, double-click it to explore the remaining neighbors. Incorrect marks can still trigger a core.
ui.help_camera: Drag to orbit; scroll or pinch to zoom. Use Top view to see the layout, or Reset to restore the starting view.
ui.keyboard_restart: starts a new survey, with confirmation during an active round.
